text: Cinder Labs is a crypto-native team building EmberStake, a staking contract for their $EMBER token -- an existing, already-deployed ERC-20.
Users will stake $EMBER to earn real ETH rewards, a share of protocol fees -- tracked in stakedBalance and rewardBalance mappings.
Once this contract is live on mainnet holding real funds, there's no patching it the way you'd patch a server.
Vivian Castellan, Head of Product, sponsors this project -- she wants real staking live on mainnet, safely.
Next: turning 'ship it safely' into one precise, testable requirement.
